dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical 2D narrowing of the body width from the mid-section toward the visible posterior end.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Uniform slate-grey skin tone across the majority of the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker-grey mottling concentrated slightly around the mid-dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse, low-contrast gradients between varying shades of grey pigment.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A prominent, high-contrast, longitudinal white linear mark on the posterior dorsal surface and a small, bright punctate mark on the mid-left dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant longitudinal linear scar extending along the posterior dorsal midline, characterized by high-contrast white pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: The blowhole is visible as a dark, elliptical aperture on the anterior dorsal surface.
